description: Java class defining the ClientCharge entity, representing charges associated with clients in the Fineract portfolio module, including methods for payment, waiver, and status management.

classes.name: ClientCharge
classes.description: Entity representing a client-specific charge, with fields for amount, status, payment, waiver, and related charge details.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ClientCharge instance from client, charge, and JSON command.

methods.name: pay
methods.description: Records a payment against the charge and updates outstanding amount.

methods.name: undoPayment
methods.description: Reverts a payment, adjusting paid and outstanding amounts.

methods.name: waive
methods.description: Waives the charge, updating amounts and status.

methods.name: undoWaiver
methods.description: Reverts a waiver, restoring amounts and status.

methods.name: populateDerivedFields
methods.description: Initializes amount fields based on charge calculation type.

methods.name: determineIfFullyPaid
methods.description: Checks if the charge is fully paid.
